text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: elevated gRPC reset and 5xx error rate observed from az1a affecting inference hosts. Pager -> @laura_oncall, @mateo_sre, @priya_runtime. Auto-triage: severity=sev2, potential cross-AZ failover recommended.
laura_oncall: ack, on it. starting blackbox and resolver checks. first glance: resolver timeouts + stream resets.
mateo_sre: seeing lots of RST_STREAM and ECONNRESET from hosts in az1a. NLB health checks flapping on a subset of pods.
priya_runtime: logs show kvcache churn then resolver cache overlap — many prefix misses causing long tail rehits. snippet: ```
[2026-03-16T12:03:21Z] resolver: cache-evict overlap, id=0x7f3
[2026-03-16T12:03:22Z] grpc: stream reset, code=RST_STREAM, err=connection reset by peer
```
alex_support: customer impact: observed ~6% error rate for 3 dedicated tenants (eu-hosted) and p95 latency increased ~300ms. No large-scale 5xx spike but visible user-facing failures for streaming calls.
laura_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) fail away 25% traffic from az1a to eu-fallback for inference routing. 2) force NLB re-register of affected targets. 3) temporary model fallback to cpu-quant variant for cold-prefix heavy customers to reduce KV pressure. 4) open AWS support case for network/eni investigation.
mateo_sre: executing re-register step now. command: ```
for t in $(aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn "arn:aws:tg:..." --query 'TargetHealthDescriptions[?Target.HealthState==`unhealthy`].Target.Id' -o text); do aws elbv2 register-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:tg:... --targets Id=$t; done
```
priya_runtime: toggled local resolver caching to fallback DNS resolver (remote) for inference runtime in az1a. rolling restart on 10% batch of pods to avoid mass cold-start kv regen. monitoring KV miss rate.
dan_ml: (joining) brief: any regression on model outputs? we saw only perf/regression in latency, not quality. good to call out to product if that changes.
alex_support: notifying affected customers via staging status messages: short note about intermittent streaming failures, working on failover. no SLA breach expected yet but tracking.
laura_oncall: creating short-term routing rule: route inference traffic with region preference policy -> if az1a returns reset(>1 per min) then prefer eu1. Implemented and testing with 10% canary.
mateo_sre: canary looks stable so far for the shifted traffic. error rate in az1a baseline still ~4-5% for remaining traffic.
aws-support-bot: Support case created: CS-20260316-0148. AWS investigating ENI/host-level network retransmits in az1a.
priya_runtime: observed kvcache regen rate reduced by ~40% after partial canary and cache-toggle. p95 latency for canary dropped back to normal.
laura_oncall: next steps: 1) keep 25% shifted for 1hr and reassess, 2) AWS case awaiting findings, 3) if errors persist >15m escalate to sev1. preparing handoff notes for night.
dan_ml: noted for handoff: watch for quality regressions when we promote model fallback — also monitor token-level deltas for top 5 tenants.
laura_oncall: handing incident to night oncall @dan_ml at 18:00 UTC. summary for handoff: ongoing resolver-related gRPC resets in az1a; 25% traffic redirected to eu fallback; NLB targets re-registered; AWS case open (CS-20260316-0148). customer impact limited but some streaming failures for dedicated tenants. contact list: @mateo_sre, @priya_runtime, @alex_support.
aws-support-bot: AWS update: initial observation shows increased RX drop and soft ENI resets on several hosts in az1a. Investigators collecting packet captures.
laura_oncall: thanks team — will drop a short status to status.redwood.ai confirming partial routing and AWS investigation.
alex_support: message posted on status (incid-2026-03-16-az1a). offering 1:1 outreach to affected enterprise customers if they want.
dan_ml: acked takeover. I'll keep watch and escalate if error rate climbs or any customer reports increased impact.
incident-bot: Incident note: thread handed to oncall dan_ml. Keep updates in this thread.
